title: Large response serialization without pagination
summary: Flask routes serialize large result sets into JSON without pagination or field selection.
rationale: Large payloads increase CPU, memory, network transfer, and client-side processing.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Add pagination, filtering, sparse fieldsets, or streaming responses where appropriate.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
